summary: INTERIM observation sheets for investigation OT-26-S0192, the VM14 channel modulator screen for Vesselquarn Medical Research Trust. HepG2 viability exposures are partly read, and micronucleus scoring is partial. Precipitation has excluded some high-concentration conditions, and repeats are pending. No final conclusions have been drawn; this workbook is not for release.
